title: CoarseGraining
abstract: A Lean formalization of the coarse-graining approach to quantitative stochastic homogenization of divergence-form elliptic equations: function-space, deterministic, probabilistic, and homogenization-scale theory up to the quenched minimal-scale theorem. The public main result is a uniformly elliptic, isotropic specialization of the quenched homogenization comparison estimate in Armstrong-Kuusi, "Renormalization Group and Elliptic Homogenization in High Contrast" (Inventiones Mathematicae, 2025), independently checked using Audit/QuenchedComparison/comparator.json, together with four further comparator-checked specializations under Audit/.
